evidence.claim: Santander participated in UK Digital Regulatory Reporting (DRR) pilot Phase 2 with FCA/BOE, testing ISDA CDM 2.0 deployment for derivatives regulatory reporting
evidence.excerpt: In addition to the FCA and BOE, Barclays, Credit Suisse, HSBC, NatWest, Santander, and Lloyds are participating in the UK Digital Regulatory Reporting pilot.
evidence.notes: DRR Phase 2 began February 2022. While dated, establishes historical engagement with CDM-based reporting.

evidence.claim: Banco Santander S.A. is registered with CFTC as a non-US swap dealer with reporting obligations
evidence.excerpt: Banco Santander, S.A. has been registered with the Commission (CFTC) as a non-U.S. swap dealer.
evidence.notes: Establishes derivatives market participation and regulatory reporting obligations.

evidence.claim: Santander US Capital Markets LLC registered as FCM with CFTC; CME clearing membership includes OTC interest rate swaps
evidence.excerpt: SanCap is registered as a Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) with the CFTC. SanCap's CME clearing membership includes OTC interest rate swaps.
evidence.notes: Confirms active derivatives clearing operations requiring regulatory reporting.

evidence.claim: Banco Santander S.A. is an adhering organization to ISDA 2013 EMIR Port Rec, Dispute Res and Disclosure Protocol
evidence.excerpt: BANCO SANTANDER, S.A. adhered to the ISDA 2013 EMIR Port Rec, Dispute Res and Disclosure Protocol.
evidence.notes: Standard ISDA protocol adherence, not CDM-specific. Historical context only.

evidence.claim: CFTC enforcement action against Santander for recordkeeping and reporting violations (January 2021 to present)
evidence.excerpt: From at least January 2021 to present, Banco Santander, S.A. and Santander US Capital Markets LLC violated Sections 4g, 4s(f)(1)(B), 4s(g)(1), and 4s(h)(1)(B) of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission Regulations related to recordkeeping and reporting requirements.
evidence.notes: Regulatory enforcement related to reporting failures. May indicate technology gaps in reporting infrastructure.
